Actual pretrained GeoAI inference — demonstration
Four small NAIP tiles, not full ZIP coverage. Green areas = model-predicted tree cover. Paths use the same orange-to-green tree-adjacency scale. Toggle routing layers to compare overlapping paths. Tree-priority selects the highest mean nearby canopy among up to 30 candidate paths within 1.5× shortest distance. The separate balanced cost trades distance for canopy. Neither measures actual shade. Tree proximity is not measured shade. Entrances and crossings remain unverified.
